newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.471 billion yuan from 931 million yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was more active than on Tuesday with some short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, borrowing actively.
The centres from grain-producing provinces, including central Hunan and Jiangxi, were active borrowers on increased fund demand during the summer harvest season, they said.
State-run banks, in particular the Agriculture Bank of China, were major lenders, traders said.
On the second-tier market, where non-banking financial institutions trade through the short-term financial centres, securities houses were major borrowers, traders said.
The securities houses borrowed money on the interbank market to prepare for trading of new shares, they said.
Traders said they expected the rates to move around current levels for the next few days due to an absence of new market-moving factors.
